description: This Java source file defines the CommandWithOptionalEntityValidator class, which implements a validation function to check commands that modify entities for potential harm, particularly illegal characters in JSON entities.

classes.name: CommandWithOptionalEntityValidator
classes.description: A singleton class implementing a validator function that checks commands with optional entities for illegal JSON content, specifically null characters, to prevent harmful modifications downstream.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the CommandWithOptionalEntityValidator class.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the validation check on the given WithDittoHeaders object, returning it if valid or throwing an exception if illegal content is found.

methods.name: checkForHarmfulEntity
methods.description: Checks whether the WithDittoHeaders object contains an entity with illegal JSON content, throwing an error if so.

methods.name: isJsonValueIllegal

methods.name: isJsonFieldIllegal
